missionText.briefing:
Your first day at the desert outpost.

A small enemy base nearby is launching
an attack. Kill all the airplanes
and destroy the base.
missionText.success:
Not bad for a first day on the job!

You are transferred to a bigger base,
congratulations!
missionText.failure: Use your firepower from your crocodiles!
